description: Operational reference with input-derived checks. Legacy comparison is rejected because it disagrees in runoff units by factor 1000 and does not contain the selected diffusive-wave routing output. No basin validation. mizuRoute 3.2.0 candidate; GNU/OpenMPI/OpenMP; diffusive wave route_opt=5; original mm/s runoff and topology Transformations: Select case1 regular input and topology members; Copy original ancillary param.nml.default instead of extracting a symlink; Set absolute /data and /output directories; Shorten end time from 1950-12-31 noon to 1950-01-03 noon; keep full input series and all parameters; explicitly select pio_netcdf_type=netcdf (classic file format), matching the supported PIO 2.6.6 serial I/O backend (upstream default pnetcdf is unavailable). Strengthened acceptance uses input-derived analytic gamma headwater hydrographs and per-reach integral storage conservation. Three daily interval-start timestamps span 1950-01-01 noon through the final bound 1950-01-04 noon. Interior transient DW accuracy is not certified.
source: Mizukami, Naoki (2025). mizuRoute testCase v3.1, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.17794327. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17794327 Archive SHA256 b65b5ab692e0c59808a93dcfd8f1ffebe4db88797cd80557dbbd228f9e90afac
expectations: one history NetCDF, 6736 unique basin IDs and 6895 unique reach IDs matched by identity
three continuous positive 86400-second time bounds from 1950-01-01T12:00 to 1950-01-04T12:00
history timestamps denote interval starts and discharges are interval means
basRunoff preserves forcing mm/s after HRU identity alignment
DWroutedRunoff dimensions (time, seg), units m3/s, finite nonnegative values
2507 headwater hydrographs match the independent gamma convolution of forcing and HRU area
all 6895 reaches satisfy integrated incoming plus lateral minus outgoing volume equals final storage
restart time equals the final interval end; restart basin_q matches the independent basin hydrograph
tolerance_rationale: Input passthrough compares exact float32 values after ID alignment. Headwater comparison allows 2e-7 relative plus 1e-10 m3/s absolute for float32 history encoding. The reach volume budget is 1e-6 m3 plus 2e-7 times the sum of absolute inflow, outflow and final storage; it accounts for rounding of both sides of the integral balance. Exact bounds/continuity and 1e-9 time-unit endpoint tolerance enforce three complete days. No candidate discharge golden is used. See containers/hydrology/NUMERICAL-REFERENCES.md for limits.
